1. Sign in via SSH in Terminal. Verify the server fingerprint and configure key authentication.

2. Import a server from SSH configuration and click Install remote agent. Linux requires vhci_hcd; installation and attachment need administrator privileges.

3. Select a server, select your board, and click Connect. Start flashing only after Mounted remotely appears.

4. Run sudo uta-server list in the remote session to locate the device, then use your existing flashing tool.
